pylons_vi: 2 tháp chữ H cải tiến: chân choãi ra dưới mặt cầu xuống bệ móng, nghiêng nhẹ vào trên mặt cầu; dầm ngang trên có vút cong lớn, dầm hộp đỡ dầm cầu; cao 93 m trên mặt cầu, 134,5 m từ đỉnh bệ (≈145 m)
pylons_en: 2 modified-H pylons: legs splay out below the deck to the pile cap and lean slightly inward above it; deep upper crossbeam with large curved haunches, box beam under the deck; 93 m above deck, 134.5 m above the pile cap (≈145 m)

pylon_custom.description: Modified H (Arcadis): two hollow concrete legs that splay outward below the deck to a large rectangular pile cap, kink at the deck and lean gently inward above it (c/c ≈ 34 m at the deck, ≈ 27 m at the tips, ≈ 44 m at the cap). A deep box crossbeam under the deck carries the girder; one deep upper crossbeam at ≈ 0.55–0.64 of the above-deck height has large curved haunches into the legs (portal soffit) and small fillets on top; the legs continue above it as two free posts with flat tops. Legs taper along the bridge (≈ 9.5 → 5.5 m) and across (≈ 5 → 3.5 m). Stays in two near-vertical planes anchored in the legs from just below the crossbeam to near the tips, landing on the deck edges. Light-grey concrete, grey stays.

model3d.notes: Spans 162.5 + 380 + 162.5 = 705 m (Structurae, SEI 2010), no auxiliary piers (aerial photo). 'Modified H' pylon (Arcadis): legs splay below the deck to the pile cap and lean slightly inward above it; deep haunched upper crossbeam at ≈ 0.6 of the above-deck height, deep box beam under the deck. Height 93 m above deck and 134.5 m above the pile-cap top (Structurae); ≈ 140 m (SEI); 145 m (Wikipedia, read as from the cap underside). Drawn 139 m from the water with the cap ≈ 4.5 m proud (photo ratio 0.69 above deck / total matches Structurae). 144 stays = 18 per side per plane (ICE design audit). Open Π-section RC deck 27.5 m, depth ≈ 2.5 m estimated. Clearance 45 m within a 250 m zone (SEI). Deck ≈ 46.5 m above water at the pylons and 48.8 m at mid-span (photo estimate).
